description: This file contains the implementation of Customer Data Access Object (DAO) named CustomerDAOImpl, which interacts with a database to perform CRUD operations and queries related to Customer entities within the sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerDAOImpl
classes.description: An implementation of the CustomerDAO interface, providing database access methods for Customer entities such as retrieval by ID, name, nickname, and listing by store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its unique ID, including fetching associated attributes and related entities.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching a given name parameter, searching by first or last name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Provides paginated and filtered list of customers associated with a specific merchant store based on provided search criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its nickname, optionally constrained by store ID, including fetching associated groups and attributes.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves all customers associated with a given merchant store without filtering.
